defects.description: FALSE POSITIVE. Geometry sweep flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) because description contains the word floor. Instructions clearly say SIT on the floor with legs crossed and weight balanced evenly on both sit bones — this is a SEATED cross-legged pose, NOT a reclining/lying pose. No globalTilt needed. Sweep keyword matching too aggressive on the word floor. Note: 29 reclining flags sweep-wide; this is one of several false positives from on the floor phrasing in seated category.

rationale: CLEAN aside from false-positive reclining flag. Verified against instructions: (1) Sit on the floor with legs crossed — derived hip flexion 80/80, knees 108.6/108.6, raw hipAbductL/R 25/25 (positive = outward spread per FK, approximates cross-legged diamond shape since renderer lacks hip external rotation joint). (2) Weight balanced evenly on both sit bones — L/R symmetric (legs mirror, no lateral tilt). (3) Rest hands lightly on the knees — L arm shoulder_abd 43.5, elbow 62.6, forearm_forward 40.9; R arm shoulder_abd 53.9, elbow 77.2, forearm_forward 49.3 — forearms forward with moderate bend, hands approximately at knee position. (4) Lift through crown of head, lengthen spine — torso flexion -8 deg (slight back extension, lifted crown). No real defects. No fix proposed.
